title: MaxTracker
shortDescription: Aggregator that automates and speeds up the search for €0 TGV Max tickets for SNCF subscribers.
problem: Searching for **€0 TGV Max tickets** on official tools is **tedious and time-consuming**, forcing users to test dates and destinations one by one.
solution: Full-Stack development of an **automated aggregator**. The tool instantly computes routes and transfers, then streamlines booking through a **targeted redirect**.
impact: **Massive time savings** and **zero user friction**. The architecture enables immediate use, **with no account creation** and no personal data collection.

title: Hub des Savoirs
shortDescription: Unified study hub: notes, spaced repetition, timed drills, and AI-generated quizzes, fully offline.
problem: Preparing for competitive exams often means juggling many tools. This fragmentation **increases cognitive load** and breaks momentum.
solution: Design of a **unified study hub** combining notes, spaced repetition, and AI quizzes. Everything is **locally synchronized** with export/restore support.
impact: **Dense, focused study sessions** with **full and secure control** over personal data.

title: Geekment Vôtre
shortDescription: Mobile e-commerce booking app for a local event services provider.
problem: Handling bookings through regular messaging **limited business growth**. The provider needed an accessible tool to **reach a wider regional audience**.
solution: Design of a **tailor-made application** acting as both showcase and growth lever: home booking, online shop, and a checkout flow **optimized for conversion**.
impact: The business **moves beyond manual operations**: a **scalable** digital presence that captures local demand and supports controlled growth.

title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
shortDescription: Interactive standalone web game, playable solo or duo, inspired by the TV quiz show.
problem: Running a TV-style quiz was either **manual** (paper, timer) or tied to a **rigid third-party platform** with limited immersion.
solution: Design of a **standalone game application** with prize ladder, lifelines, and customizable themes, plus installable (**PWA**) mode for **offline play**.
impact: **Instant immersive hosting** without external accounts or third-party dependency. The full experience remains under the organizer's **complete control**.

title: Monster Slayer
shortDescription: Turn-based combat mini-game built as a front-end skills showcase.
problem: Proving mastery of **complex dynamic UI states** requires more than a static webpage.
solution: Development of an **interactive technical showcase** focused on **robust state management**, clear business rules, and fully responsive UX.
impact: A **concrete proof of concept**: a usable game demonstrating end-to-end capability to design and deliver an interactive interface.

title: Discord Bots Simplon
shortDescription: Centralized API and business Discord bots for a regional training organization.
problem: The organization relied on **manual and improvised workflows**. Missing governance increased repetitive tasks and slowed daily operations.
solution: A **centralized architecture** with one API orchestrating multiple business bots, including technical documentation and **standardized deployment**.
impact: **Automation of recurring tasks** and major reduction in facilitation workload, built on a **maintainable and reliable** foundation.

title: AIR Dashboard (FLE)
shortDescription: Secure dashboard centralizing beneficiary tracking for an integration-focused nonprofit.
problem: Administrative tracking was spread across Excel files, causing **information loss**, duplicate entries, and daily **mental overhead**.
solution: Full-Stack development of a **custom dashboard** designed to **centralize the data layer** and streamline administrative workflows.
impact: **More reliable tracking**, around **5 hours saved per week**, and instant access to critical records without scattered spreadsheets.

title: Marche et Deviens
shortDescription: C# / .NET proof of concept (API + UI) to technically validate a company digital overhaul.
problem: Before investing in a large technical initiative, the client lacked concrete visibility and risked making **decisions in the dark**.
solution: Design of a **business-oriented proof of concept**, iterated through weekly syncs to quickly validate ergonomics and **architecture options**.
impact: **Faster decision-making** with **tangible demonstrations**, enabling confident choices without committing budget to untested assumptions.
